principle: Line 1 evidence requirements are dictated by downstream capability needs (P0 CTM Bootstrap vs P1 Schedule vs P2 Telemetry), NOT by replicating Line 3's exact record counts.

P0_CTM_BOOTSTRAP.purpose: Enables Line 1 representation in CTM and activates multi-line Journey Graph pathfinding with Line 3 via Marol Naka interchange.
requiredAttributes: interchanges (D.N. Nagar with Line 2A/2B; WEH with Line 7; Marol Naka with Line 3; Andheri with WR; Ghatkopar with CR)
P0_CTM_BOOTSTRAP.estimatedAcquisitionEffort: LOW (already largely captured in network registry & OSM)

P1_SCHEDULE_SYNTHESIS.purpose: Enables static timetable generation (stop_times.txt, frequencies.txt) and scheduled journey planning.
requiredAttributes: service_span (first train / last train by terminal)
P1_SCHEDULE_SYNTHESIS.estimatedAcquisitionEffort: MEDIUM (Agent 2 can acquire from MMOPL website and circulars)

P2_PREDICTION_AND_TELEMETRY.purpose: Enables vehicle dynamics simulation and real-time arrival estimation.
P2_PREDICTION_AND_TELEMETRY.estimatedAcquisitionEffort: HIGH (requires technical study or GTFS-RT API access)

agentSplit.agent1_role: Agent 1 (Technical Baseline Extractor) extracts design parameters, station chainages, and engineering specs from DPR / official reports.
agentSplit.agent2_role: Agent 2 (Current-State & External Verification Agent) inspects MMOPL portal, Google Maps entrance points, and Overpass GIS to provide current operational observations.
agentSplit.reconciliation_rule: Agent 1 provides HISTORICAL_DESIGN baseline; Agent 2 provides CURRENT_OPERATIONAL observations. Reconciliation layer detects discrepancies and generates CTM candidates without either agent modifying CTM directly.
